mapper.insert: insert into orders (number, user_id, address_book_id, order_time, checkout_time, amount, remark, phone, address, user_name, consignee, cancel_reason, rejection_reason, cancel_time, estimated_delivery_time, delivery_status,delivery_time, pack_amount, tableware_number, tableware_status) values (#{number}, #{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{orderTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{userName}, #{consignee}, #{cancelReason}, #{rejectionReason}, #{cancelTime}, #{estimatedDeliveryTime},#{deliveryStatus}, #{deliveryTime}, #{packAmount}, #{tablewareNumber}, #{tablewareStatus})
mapper.select: select * from orders where number = #{number} and user_id = #{userId}
select count(id) from orders where status = #{status}
select * from orders where status = #{status} and order_time < #{time}
